items.name: Torso rotations
items.note: Club across the chest, turn back and through. Wake the coil up.

items.name: Hip openers
items.note: Stand on one leg, circle the other knee out and round.

items.name: Shoulder windmills
items.note: Big arm circles, forwards then backwards.

items.name: Wrist flexors
items.note: Arm out straight, pull the fingers back, then push them down.

items.name: 58° wedge
items.note: Half swings. Find the middle of the face.

items.name: 50° wedge
items.note: Three quarters, let it release.

items.name: 9 iron
items.note: Easy full swings, carrying the tempo up from the wedges.

items.name: 7 iron
items.note: Trust the feel. There have been some lovely strikes lately.

items.name: Driver
items.note: Tight landing zone, commit to the shape.

items.name: Torso rotations
items.note: Arms crossed, hips still, shoulders turning as far as they will go.

items.name: Hip openers
items.note: Deep lunge, press the hips forward. Nothing forced.

items.name: Arm circles
items.note: Start small, finish big. Shoulders and upper back.

items.name: Wrist flexor stretch
items.note: Arm out, pull the fingers back gently. Soft hands for the wedges.

items.name: Standing torso twist
items.note: Club behind the shoulders, easy twists side to side.

items.name: 58° wedge
items.note: Half swings. Rhythm first, distance later.

items.name: 54° wedge
items.note: Three quarters. This is a scoring club, so give it a proper look.

items.name: 50° wedge
items.note: Full tempo now.

items.name: 8 iron
items.note: Full swings at a target. Mid irons have been holding up.

items.name: 6 iron
items.note: Commit to each one. These are a strength.

items.name: 4 iron
items.note: Full swings with intent.

items.name: 3 iron
items.note: Game speed. Get comfortable with it off a tee.

items.name: 3 wood
items.note: Tight target. Extra reps, contact has been patchy.

items.name: Driver
items.note: Fairway targets. The strikes are there, the consistency is not.

items.name: Hip rotations
items.note: Wide stance, hands on hips, big slow circles.

items.name: Torso twists
items.note: Club across the shoulders, turn it like a backswing.

items.name: Shoulder rolls
items.note: Big slow circles, forwards then backwards.

items.name: Wrist flexion and extension
items.note: Arm out, fingers back, then fingers down. Both hands.

items.name: Dynamic leg swings
items.note: Hold onto something and swing the leg front to back.

items.name: Side bends
items.note: Club overhead, lean one way then the other.

items.name: 58° wedge
items.note: Half swings, middle of the face, nothing else.

items.name: 54° wedge
items.note: Three quarters, feel it release through the ball.

items.name: 50° wedge
items.note: Full tempo, trusting what you just built.

items.name: 9 iron
items.note: Solid lately, so keep it clean.

items.name: 7 iron
items.note: Full swings, pick a line and commit.

items.name: 5 iron
items.note: Trust the strike, the long irons are coming round.

items.name: 3 iron
items.note: Full release. Good when you commit, poor when you steer.

items.name: Driver
items.note: Tight fairway lines, full commitment.

items.name: 3 wood
items.note: Game speed, trust the setup.

items.name: Driver
items.note: Last reps. Narrow the focus, see the shot first.

items.name: Speed calibration
items.note: From 30 to 40 feet at a fringe, not a hole. You are learning today’s pace. Every one finishing within a putter length.

items.name: Slope check
items.note: Same 20 footer up the slope then back down it. Feel what the slope is worth today.

items.name: Short circle
items.note: Six around the hole at three feet. Make all six before you move on.

items.name: Gate putt
items.note: Two tees just wider than the ball. Same gate as your Pressure Gate drill, four clean ones.

items.name: Last putt
items.note: One five footer, full routine. Hole it, then walk to the first tee.

items.name: Bump and run
items.note: 8 iron or 54. Landing spot a third of the way, let it release out.

items.name: Standard chip
items.note: 54 degree, ball back, hands forward. Land it on your spot every time.

items.name: Higher soft chip
items.note: 58 degree, face slightly open. For the short-sided ones.

items.name: From the rough
items.note: Drop them in rough at 15 to 20 yards. Your weakest lie, so get a look at it before you tee off.

items.name: Up and down test
items.note: Three chips, putt each one out. Two up and downs before you leave.
